segments.text: Most restoration software was built for a different market. American building practice, American insurers, American paperwork.
Then it was translated. The currency changed, the spelling changed, and every assumption underneath stayed exactly where it was.
RestoreAssist was built here, for how the work is actually done in Australia and New Zealand.
Local building methods and climate. Local insurer expectations. ABN and GST handled as standard, not as a regional setting somebody remembered to add.
Australian English throughout, dates the right way around, and pricing in dollars that are already yours.
Built by people who have run these jobs, in these conditions.
See how it handles your next claim.
